description: Add or replace the icon (name icon, up to 256 KB) or a screenshot (shot-1 to shot-5, up to 1 MB) of an app you own. content is base64 PNG, JPEG or WebP and content_type must match. Call it after publish_app.

api_key.description: Optional slop_ API key. Use this when the client cannot send Authorization: Bearer.

slug.description: Slug of an app you own.

name: upload_media
title: Upload an icon or screenshot
